name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.47.0 takes up eleven items, eight of them from a review that compared the plugin with a vendor prompting guide, one a request handled in the same review and two carried over from v0.46.0: a contributor guide at the repository root that is not installed into vaults; optional jarvis.model and jarvis.effort settings that add --model and --effort to the Telegram bridge only when they are not empty; a scheduled briefing slot that is given up after 8 failed attempts in a row with one notice to the owner; an optional dated reason when a lesson is retired; a completion condition for process-inbox; session-end records written for a reader who did not see the session; wording fixes; an opt-in /aside-repl procedure command for the Aside adapter that injects no shell command; a test fixture fix; and errata for the v0.46.0 documents. A planned contract line on engine-copy ownership failed its wording test and was not shipped, so the rule files are unchanged. Some default results change; the release note lists each one. The seven certificate-bound checker files are unchanged from v0.46.0, so certificates made with v0.46.0 stay valid when the installed bytes match. For transitions from v0.45.1 or earlier, where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime and hook bindings stay unchanged. Publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
